description: Carter and the residents of Eureka confront new scientific disasters while changes at Global Dynamics and the consequences of earlier experiments deepen the town's personal and institutional conflicts.

s02e01.description: Back in the restored timeline, Carter and Henry struggle with what they lost while people across Eureka begin spontaneously combusting and Stark waits to learn whether the DOD will keep him in charge of Global Dynamics.

s02e02.description: On Allison’s first day running Global Dynamics, Fargo activates a mysterious device that generates an expanding personal force field, trapping him and threatening the entire facility.

s02e03.description: A surprise visitor unsettles Carter and Zoe just as a localized deep freeze triggers a chain of violent weather shifts that could culminate in a deadly ice funnel over Eureka.

s02e04.description: After a blow to the head, Carter finds himself in a version of Eureka where residents keep vanishing and only he notices, forcing him to determine whether the town or his own mind has changed.

s02e05.description: A cloud of orbital debris begins raining down on Eureka during the school science fair, and Carter discovers Zoe may be connected to the growing danger above the town.

s02e06.description: An experimental accident causes Eureka residents to begin sharing dreams, at first embarrassing and amusing, until the overlapping subconscious visions become dangerous in the waking world.

s02e07.description: Fargo’s grandfather Pierre is awakened from a cryogenic chamber after fifty years and insists he was frozen against his will, prompting Carter to investigate what really happened to him in 1957.

s02e08.description: A project designed to recreate the first moments of the universe goes wrong and rapidly reduces Eureka’s geniuses to near helplessness, leaving Carter and newly arrived prodigy Zane to save the town.

s02e09.description: Radiation and unexplained activity at Global Dynamics point to an abandoned invisibility project, and Carter accidentally becomes invisible himself before the unstable process can be reversed.

s02e10.description: A series of seemingly biblical plagues sweeps through Eureka, sending the town into panic while Carter searches for the scientific mechanism connecting the bizarre events.

s02e11.description: Women across Eureka become uncontrollably attracted to Carter, turning his sudden popularity into a medical emergency as he tries to discover what is altering everyone’s behavior.

s02e12.description: Metal objects and eventually people begin turning into gold as a runaway biological process spreads through Eureka, forcing Global Dynamics into a race to contain the transformation.

s02e13.description: The metal-eating organism becomes airborne and Global Dynamics locks down, trapping Carter and Stark inside as they work together to save both Eureka and Allison’s son Kevin.
